final:
rotl8(x: u8, k: int) -> u8 =
  pre k >= 0 and k <= 7
  post bits.count_ones(out) == bits.count_ones(x)
  ex rotl8(129 as u8, 1) == 3 as u8
  ex rotl8(1 as u8, 0) == 1 as u8
  ex rotl8(1 as u8, 7) == 128 as u8
  bits.rotate_left(x, k as u8)
